summary: Iteration 6: Backend pytest suite (11/11 PASS) covers public settings exposure, admin settings PUT validation (merchant_upi must contain '@', lat/lng ranges), per-user weekly cadence on assign (first due = start+7d), UPI mark-paid creates next pending, and cash mark-paid endpoint anchored to prev_due+7d with notification + cash txn id starting CASH-. Frontend (Expo web preview) verified: B1 customer home renders pickup-address-card with seeded address+coords and Directions opens https://www.google.com/maps/...?query=17.527688,78.394619; B2 /customer/vehicle renders pickup card above 'Rental Info'; B5 admin /admin/settings shows all 7 new testIDs and save+reload round-trip for merchant-upi works (changed to test.upi@upi then restored to vemula.balajee@ybl). B3 (customer payments openUpi) and B4 (admin payments cash button) partially verified — modal opens / wiring is correct in code, but Playwright selectors could not 100% complete the click path (see issues). Deprecated style warnings observed but not blocking. merchant_upi has been restored to 'vemula.balajee@ybl' at end of run.

critical.issue: Spec A5 requires next pending due_date = previous due_date + 7d for BOTH UPI and cash mark-paid. server.py line 591 uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=7) for the UPI path — so weekly cadence drifts every time a UPI payment is recorded late. Only admin_mark_cash_paid uses prev_due + 7d correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Pending payment list rows do not expose a stable testID for the row Pressable (only the pencil icon has 'edit'). Playwright could not reliably open the edit modal to verify the mark-cash-paid-button click path. Backend endpoint itself is verified (11/11 tests).

Prominent action buttons (Pay Now, Quick Pay via UPI) lack stable testID (e.g. 'quick-pay-upi-button', 'pay-now-button'). They work — the UPI confirmation modal opens — but it makes integration tests harder.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py weekly-cadence cash path correctly uses prev_due+7d (lines 700-720), but UPI mark-paid path (lines 589-596) still uses now+7d — inconsistent with spec.
Payment.payment_method optional field is in the model; UPI path now sets it to 'upi' on mark-paid (good). Cash sets 'cash' (good).

PickupAddressCard.tsx safely returns null when /settings/public throws — but a pending or unauthenticated user will silently see no card. Consider rendering a static fallback for unauth/pending cases.

rca_of_issue: Spec A5: 'next pending due_date = previous due_date + 7 days' for ANY mark-paid call. server.py:591 computes due = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=7) for the UPI path, NOT previous_due + 7d. As a result, if a user pays late, their weekly anchor day shifts forward. Cash path at lines 700-717 does it correctly (prev_due_dt + timedelta(days=7)). Fix: in mark_payment_paid, parse p['due_date'] and use prev_due + 7d (with tzinfo fallback to utc), matching admin_mark_cash_paid. Reproduction: assign vehicle at Wed 14:00 UTC → first pending due Wed+7. Pay UPI on Fri → next due is Fri+7 instead of next Wed.
